title: Compatibility with derived unit
statement: Given the affine sheaf edge ε, its composite with exact-homology comparisons agrees with homology of the right-derived functor unit for every exact quasi-coherent-valued F and every admissible complex C.

source.place: 0AVW, proof, cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison, applied on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: Compare a K-injective resolution after F and after termwise direct image; exactness identifies both cycle classes, and the defining naturality square identifies the comparison with the right-derived unit.
